This page lists 70 Sublime Text keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `sublime-text.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Sublime Text to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t sublime-text.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/sublime-text.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Sublime Text.app`; if Sublime Text lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Editing

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘X` | Cut line |
| `⌘⏎` | Insert line after |
| `⇧⌘⏎` | Insert line before |
| `⌃⌘↑` | Move line/selection up |
| `⌃⌘↓` | Move line/selection down |
| `⌘L` | Select line (repeat for next lines) |
| `⌘D` | Select word (repeat for next occurrence) |
| `⌃⌘G` | Select all occurrences of selection |
| `⌃⇧↑` | Extra cursor on line above |
| `⌃⇧↓` | Extra cursor on line below |
| `⌃M` | Jump to closing/opening parentheses |
| `⌃⇧M` | Select all contents in parentheses |
| `⌃A` | Move to beginning of line |
| `⌘←` | Move to beginning of text on line |
| `⌃E` | Move to end of line |
| `⌘→` | Move to end of line |
| `⌘K⌘K` | Delete from cursor to end of line |
| `⌘K⌘⌫` | Delete from cursor to start of line |
| `⌘]` | Indent current line(s) |
| `⌘[` | Un-indent current line(s) |
| `⇧⌘D` | Duplicate line(s) |
| `⌘J` | Join line below to current line |
| `⌘/` | Comment/un-comment current line |
| `⌥⌘/` | Block comment current selection |
| `⌘Y` | Redo or repeat last shortcut |
| `⇧⌘V` | Paste and indent correctly |
| `⌃Space` | Select next auto-complete suggestion |
| `⌘U` | Soft undo |
| `⌃⇧W` | Wrap selection in HTML tag |
| `⌃⇧K` | Delete current line |

## Navigation

Goto Anywhere features.

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘P` | Quick-open files by name |
| `⌘T` | Quick-open files by name |
| `⌘R` | Goto symbol |
| `⌃G` | Goto line in current file |

## General

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘P` | Command Palette |
| `` ⌃` `` | Python Console |
| `⌃⌘F` | Toggle fullscreen mode |
| `⌃⇧⌘F` | Toggle distraction-free mode |
| `⌘K⌘B` | Toggle side bar |
| `⌃⇧P` | Show scope in status bar |

## Find & Replace

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘F` | Find |
| `⌥⌘F` | Replace |
| `⇧⌘F` | Find in files |
| `⌘I` | Incremental Find |

## Scrolling

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌃V` | Scroll down one page |
| `⌃L` | Center current line vertically |
| `⌘↓` | Scroll to end of file |
| `⌘↑` | Scroll to start of file |

## Tabs

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇧⌘T` | Open last closed tab |
| `⌘1-9` | Jump to tab in current group |
| `⌘0` | Jump to 10th tab |
| `⇧⌘[` | Cycle left through tabs |
| `⇧⌘]` | Cycle right through tabs |
| `⌃⇥` | Cycle up through recent tabs |
| `⌃⇧⇥` | Cycle down through recent tabs |

## Split Window

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘1` | Revert to single column |
| `⌥⌘2` | Split into two columns |
| `⌥⌘3` | Split into three columns |
| `⌥⌘4` | Split into four columns |
| `⌥⌘5` | Set view to grid (4 groups) |
| `⌃1-4` | Jump to group |
| `⌃⇧1-4` | Move file to specified group |

## Bookmarks

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘F2` | Toggle bookmark |
| `F2` | Next bookmark |
| `⇧F2` | Previous bookmark |
| `⇧⌘F2` | Clear bookmarks |

## Text Manipulation

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌘K⌘U` | Transform to Uppercase |
| `⌘K⌘L` | Transform to Lowercase |
| `⌃⌘↑` | Clip text upwards |
| `⌃⌘↓` | Clip text downwards |

## Template file

The full [`sublime-text.keyly`](https://github.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/blob/main/templates/sublime-text.keyly) file. Copy it into `~/.config/keyly/templates/` to edit it, or [write your own](/configuration/custom-shortcuts/).
